description: Spacious and generous. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: L-shaped or U-shaped, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. Two cooks can work simultaneously on separate counter runs. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: Two sofas in upper-left forming an L facing into the living room; a separate sofa unit in the centre-left facing down toward the dining area. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is blank wall, L-shaped corridor, short. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower, bathtub, and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child. Not suitable for: people needing a dedicated home office (no desk space in bedrooms); large families requiring more than two bedrooms; those wanting bedrooms with strong natural light.
